question: Could you review our records in June 2022 and identify which countries have the longest streak of consecutive inserted city dates? Please list the 2-letter length country codes of these countries.
sql:
WITH distinct_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        country_code_2,
        CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) as day_num
    FROM cities 
    WHERE insert_date LIKE '2022-06-%'
),
with_streak_id AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        day_num,
        day_num - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY day_num) as streak_id
    FROM distinct_dates
),
streak_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        streak_id,
        COUNT(*) as streak_length
    FROM with_streak_id
    GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_id
),
max_streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        MAX(streak_length) as max_streak
    FROM streak_counts
    GROUP BY country_code_2
)
SELECT 
    country_code_2,
    max_streak
FROM max_streaks
ORDER BY max_streak DESC, country_code_2
LIMIT 10
